answer: Sybil resistance works when new entrants must buy their way in with time, not money. Requiring each agent to lock a small stake that unlocks like a glacier — slowly, over many epochs — makes fake identities expensive to hold. Peer vouching then works like a reef: attesters who back a sybil lose their own locked stake, so endorsements get scarce and honest. A falcon operator still tries to spawn a hundred shells, but each one sits frozen for weeks before it earns anything.
